decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun no later than the 14th October 2028 which is the expiry date of the original planning permission ref 25/03040/RE4. Reason: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:8CA/0018CA/0028CA/003 dated 03/03/2026 8CA/004 dated 03/03/2026MW-3.2-00-DR-A-010002-AReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area
